scope: the 31 *-implement/skill.json files; consolidation part B, plan step 4 of kb/ceremonies/consolidation-review.json
method: Every instructions[].action, contract.invariants[].text, contract.not_exposed[].text and best_practices[].text row was extracted from all 31 -implement skills (653 rows). Rows were grouped two ways: (1) normalised text - lowercased, backticks dropped, punctuation stripped, whitespace collapsed - clustered greedily within one row kind at difflib ratio >= 0.72, keeping only clusters spanning 3 or more skills; (2) identical (cited fact id, verbatim quote) pairs spanning 3 or more skills. Clusters are listed with the owner discipline that already states the row, and the action taken.

near_duplicate_clusters.representative_text: Keep every statement about runtime behaviour labelled claimed until that evidence record exists, and never upgrade a label by rewording a sentence.
near_duplicate_clusters.why: 'Keep every statement labelled claimed until that evidence record exists' is build-evidence-record's own sentence (it states claimed versus measured and what a record contains). Every skill carrying this instruction also carries an invariant on the same point, so the instruction is deleted and the invariant becomes the single pointer to the owner.

near_duplicate_clusters.representative_text: Run the definition of done below, then run its breakage, and record both outputs as an evidence record naming the code version and the tree hash under test before calling this capability done.
near_duplicate_clusters.replacement: Apply build-definition-of-done: run the definition of done below and then its deliberate breakage, and record both outputs the way build-evidence-record fixes, before calling this facet done; proposed pointer, see those skills.
near_duplicate_clusters.why: Criterion plus deliberate breakage plus both recorded outputs is build-definition-of-done's whole discipline; the record's fields are build-evidence-record's. Six skills stated it verbatim.

near_duplicate_clusters.representative_text: Make the conformance run adapter-parameterised from the start: one command, one report shape, `--adapter` selecting which implementation serves, and `selected_by` recorded in the report.
near_duplicate_clusters.replacement: Apply build-adapter-pair: run one conformance suite parameterised over both adapters, selected by configuration with no code edit between runs, and record selected_by in the report; proposed pointer, see that skill and its references/conformance-run-shape.md.
near_duplicate_clusters.why: One suite run once per adapter, selected by configuration, is build-adapter-pair's step. The report shape it did not yet fix - one command, one report, selected_by declared and the adapter that answered read back - was added to that skill's references/conformance-run-shape.md so the pointer has somewhere to point.
